audience: project managers and teams that plan tasks and log time in Teamwork.com

useCases.title: Find tasks due this week
useCases.text: List the tasks of one project, one task list or all visible projects. Filter by assignee or due date. Open one task for its details.

useCases.title: Review projects, task lists and members
useCases.text: List the projects, then the task lists of one project. List the people on that project.

useCases.title: Check logged time by task or project
useCases.text: List time entries of one task or one project for a date range. Each entry shows minutes, the billable flag, user and date.

useCases.title: Create a task in a task list
useCases.text: Find the task list. Create a task with a name, an optional description, and start and due dates.

useCases.title: Complete, reopen or move a task
useCases.text: Mark a task complete, or reopen a completed task. Change a task's dates or move it to another task list.

useCases.title: Log time on a task
useCases.text: Find the task. Add a time entry for one day, with hours, minutes or both.
